accordion.$description: Expandable disclosure rows. Built 2026-09-07 for the Explore Degrees results — its entire Degree Requirements tab is these: one row per requirement, showing a status icon, a name, a 'Covered / Still to do' label and a chevron, expanding to the classes that count toward it. Native-first like every other disclosure in this system: a real `<details>`/`<summary>` pair, so open/close, keyboard operation and find-in-page all work with no JS at all — the same reasoning behind Tooltip being pure CSS and Popover/Modal using the native APIs. **Rows, not boxes:** an accordion here is a flush list divided by hairlines, and the consumer wraps it in a Card if it needs an edge. That is deliberate — the reference stacks bordered boxes and it reads as a pile; a divided list of the same content reads as a list. The status icon and the trailing meta label are both optional slots, because the reference has rows without either (sub-options inside a requirement, like 'Psych 100 Level Elective'). Deferred: single-open (accordion group) behaviour — that needs the `name` attribute on `<details>`, which is worth adopting when a consumer actually wants only one row open at a time; and a nested/second-level variant.

gap.$description: Between the status icon, the title, the meta label and the chevron.

divider.$description: Hairline between rows; the last row's is dropped so it never doubles the wrapping Card's own edge — the same rule Table's row divider follows.

meta.$description: The trailing state label ('Covered', 'Still to do'). Quiet on purpose: the icon already carries the state, this just names it.

body.$description: The expanded region. It inherits the row's horizontal padding so its content lines up with the title above it, and adds bottom padding only — the summary's own padding already spaces the top.

bg.$description: The wash tier: a summary row rests on a white/transparent surface, so it takes fill.neutralHover (gray.100), not the Strong pair.
